title: cDNA synthesis for BCR-ABL1 detection at the MMR level
author: Chi, Pierides, et al.

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from bone marrow or peripheral blood of healthy individuals or Ph‑positive CML patients using the QIAamp® RNA Blood Mini Kit on the QiaCube automated platform (QIAGEN).

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA following the manufacturer’s protocol, using 10 μg of input RNA and adjusting the final reaction volume to 50 μl with ddH2O.

steps.title: Store cDNA
steps.instruction: Store the synthesized cDNA at –30 °C overnight before proceeding to RQ‑PCR.
